title: Google Chromium V8: attackers can run their own code
verdictReason: Attacks are confirmed. The vulnerability is 60 days old, so many systems are likely still unpatched.

category.label: Computers, phones and browsers
category.why: It runs on staff computers, phones or browsers.
category.doThis: Install the latest updates on every device, and turn on automatic updates.

summary: Google Chromium V8 contains an out of bounds write vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.
fix: CISA's instruction: apply the vendor's fix, or stop using the product if no fix exists. The deadline CISA set for US federal agencies, Sep 23, 2026, has passed. It is a US government deadline; use it as a guide.

CISA Vulnrichment marks CVE-2026-87491 as actively exploited
